criticalChange_2_2_1: Beacon boosting is now ADDITIVE, not multiplicative, AND unpowered beacons were buffed while powered beacons were nerfed. Aqua-stacking is therefore substantially weaker than every pre-June-2026 guide assumes. All `beaconBias` values for aqua below are inherited from the old multiplicative meta and are FLAGGED FOR RE-DERIVATION — do not trust them.
note: Archetypes are the mechanism for conditional mission priority. Your FIRST mission largely commits the run (only ~3 grey beacons exist). `core` missions identify the archetype; `followups` are ordered tiers — items within a tier are equal-value. This replaces hardcoded if/then chains.

archetypes.name: Combo 1 — Chest / Ostinato
archetypes.notes: Self-sustaining pull->chest->boon loop. Hoarder makes Blue Beacons largely redundant, so blue is downranked once online.
archetypes.coresNote: TWO independent cores. Interest Scheme + Jester's is good alone; Ostinato + Hoarder is a separate pull generator. With 3 slots you take one pair plus a piece of the other.

archetypes.name: Combo 3 — Purple

sequencing.rule: Bank 6 curses before taking a Blue Beacon (6 x +100% = +600% potency cap, per 2.2.1).
sequencing.why: Taking blue early wastes the entire Equilibrium multiplier.
Madman caps at 8 curses; it is a static snapshot, so it never improves after being taken.

archetypes.buffedIn: 2.2.1 doubled Equilibrium (+50%->+100%, cap +300%->+600%). This archetype is now materially stronger than community guides rate it.
archetypes.notes: Inner Peace belongs here despite sounding contradictory: it halves curse DIFFICULTY while curse COUNT payoffs still fire.
archetypes.pickOneOfNote: Expert: "between complete chaos equilibrium and inner peace its upto the user". Equilibrium specifically when death risk is real; unnecessary in long runs due to Chronotrigger.

archetypes.name: Salvage — raw reroll / sac
archetypes.notes: All In converts each sac into +3 rerolls at run end. Sacs have diminishing returns (50%/75%/87.5%) so cap the stack at 3 and pivot to rerolls.
archetypes.coreNote: Expert: for a failing run, add missions that give reroll and sac RAW (unconditional). High Roller and Redemption are the only two.
archetypes.trialPreferenceWhy: Converts a dead run into end-reward rerolls. Or just ditch the run.

archetypes.name: Ostinato (pull generator — combo 1b / combo 6)
archetypes.boonSelectionRule: INVERTS normal boon advice: deliberately take DUPLICATE boon types (+1 pull each). Blue and yellow (boon/chest sources) are therefore up, not down.
archetypes.notes: Confirmed by playtest (Mujtaba, 2026-07-23): blues were the strongest beacon on an Ostinato run, because every boon taken is +1 pull per duplicate. Hard anti-synergy with Opal Offering (which wants high potency, not duplicates).

routes.note: boons via blue beacons — the pivot when the chest route dies

archetypes.name: No Commitment
archetypes.notes: The correct fallback when no archetype has formed. These are stateless and never dead. Prefer them over a speculative archetype core when only 1 grey beacon remains.

archetypes.name: Combo 2 — Opal
archetypes.coreNote: Expert: "opal is its own core, everything runs on opal" — and "u could practically run anything on it". Low-conditionality, hence SAFE.
archetypes.forbiddenTrialsWhy: Expert: "never ever take things like lights out — or anything that has a chance to give u curses during opal".
archetypes.notes: Removes almost all bloat and gives a good amount of pulls.

archetypes.name: Combo 6 — Mix-match (Ostinato/Porph/Route Indigo)
archetypes.notes: Expert: "a weird mix match combo of ostinatio porph equi route indigo". Route Indigo boosts purple AND blue by 1 tier but obscures which is which.

archetypes.name: Side combo — Thrill Seeker + Knife Edge
archetypes.coreNote: Expert: "its not good i mean but they both go together... they pair together to give a decent amount of pull". PAIR ONLY — neither is worth a slot alone.
archetypes.notes: Takeable as a SIDE combo when you already have something like Porph + Sac Ritual. See the guide Run Combos "passive combo" section.

beaconBiasNote: beaconBias adds directly to a beacon's phase score (phase ranks are spaced by 10). Applied by evaluateOffer once an archetype is committed. Positive = prioritise, negative = downrank. These are opinions, tune freely.
